correctness.rationale: The binary-increment normal form f(1)=1 and f(i+1)-f(i) in {0,1} is a bijection for all n. For independent F,G the active jumps of G address pairwise distinct outer increments U_1,...,U_{G(n)-1}; conditioning on G then averaging over independent V_i factors the joint generating polynomial as ∏(1-pq+pq t_i). Thus the FULL output increment vector is iid Bernoulli(pq), not merely its rank. Induction gives all k factors and exact map fiber multiplicity (2^k-1)^(n-r). The absorbing map has all bits zero, giving exact hitting/TV laws and the lattice-window binomial-Poisson cutoff. n=1 and p,q=0 or1 are explicitly accounted for. Fresh independent actual-map composition checks: 36 parameter/fiber tests for n<=6 and k<=4; these do not establish the general statement.
